artist.bio: lo-fi postcards from the Tenderloin. tape-warm beats, golden-hour chords, and stories from the last shift. new tracks weekly - every play of 30 seconds or more counts, so press play and let it ride.

tracks.title: Saltair Meditations
tracks.description: A dusty, warm, and reflective lo-fi hip-hop track capturing the quiet, misty atmosphere of a coastal boardwalk before dawn, with shimmering Rhodes, brushed snare, and distant echoing vocal textures.

tracks.title: Balcony Snowfall
tracks.description: A warm, nostalgic instrumental lo-fi hip-hop track at 75 BPM in A minor, evoking the quiet melancholy of snowfall seen from a balcony at dusk with dusty Rhodes, brushed snare, and reverse guitar swells.

tracks.title: Cassette Haze
tracks.description: An intimate, dusty instrumental at 72 BPM capturing the nostalgic, cozy atmosphere of a tiny cassette shop with Rhodes chords, warm tape saturation, and soft boom-bap rhythm.

tracks.title: Rainstreak Rides
tracks.description: A slow, nostalgic lo-fi hip-hop instrumental remix featuring a tape-warped Rhodes piano, dusty boom-bap drums, round sub-bass, and atmospheric night-bus rain ambience.

tracks.title: Harbor Solitude
tracks.description: A late-night lo-fi soul instrumental capturing the stillness of an empty harbor after midnight, with warm gospel-tinged organ, deep sub-bass, and natural dockside field recordings.

tracks.title: Before the Spill
tracks.description: A warm, nostalgic lo-fi hip-hop instrumental set in a quiet coffee shop at dawn. Features tape-saturated electric piano, loose brushed drums, a round upright bass, and authentic morning soundscapes.

tracks.title: laundromat lullaby
tracks.description: A quiet, slow-burn lo-fi hip-hop instrumental featuring a dusty piano loop with heavy tape warble, swinging boom-bap drums, sub-bass, and rain sound effects.

tracks.title: Tenderloin Dusk
tracks.description: A mellow, golden-hour lo-fi hip-hop instrumental capturing dusk over the Tenderloin with dusty Rhodes, street ambience, and a conversational muted trumpet.

tracks.title: Golden Hour
tracks.description: An upbeat, communal instrumental groove blending Afrobeat guitars, congas, live drums, and a whistling-trumpet call-and-response, layered with warm outdoor party ambience.

tracks.title: Golden Hour Gatherings
tracks.description: An upbeat, communal instrumental groove blending Afrobeat guitars, congas, live drums, and a whistling-trumpet call-and-response, layered with warm outdoor party ambience.

tracks.title: Lazy Sunday Smile
tracks.description: A warm, sunlit 92 BPM soul-folk tune about finding beauty in human flaws. Features a cozy, conversational male vocal, lazy drums, Wurlitzer, glockenspiel highlights, loose late horns, and a rowdy gang-vocal finish.

tracks.title: Golden Porch Jam
tracks.description: An upbeat, communal instrumental groove with Afrobeat-tinged guitars, whistled melodies, muted trumpet, and a warm party background atmosphere.

tracks.title: Sunlit Groove
tracks.description: A sunlit, scrappy, and grinning mid-tempo soul-folk song defending the beauty of human imperfection. Built on a lazy backbeat, warm Wurlitzer, loose brass, and a glockenspiel doubling the hook, ending in rough, friendly gang vocals.

tracks.title: Built from Quiet
tracks.description: An intimate, slow-building folk ballad about radical self-reliance. It starts desolate with a single voice and guitar, and gradually assembles a warm, rich acoustic arrangement with brushed drums and choir-like backing vocals, ending in a powerful, quiet invincibility.

tracks.title: Corners of Blue
tracks.description: A bittersweet lo-fi instrumental hip-hop track featuring chopped dusty piano samples, a hard-swung boom-bap beat, and a pitch-stretched siren acting as a mournful horn line.

tracks.title: Static Heartbeat
tracks.description: A slow, restrained blues about the unseen monthly work of keeping well water drinkable, using rust and filtration as a literal burden that gradually opens into self-reckoning.

tracks.title: Rust in the Filter
tracks.description: A slow-burning, minimalist blues song with grainy close-mic'd male vocals, skeletal tremolo guitar, sparse drums, and Wurlitzer. A metaphorical look at the literal labor of replacing a water filter.

tracks.title: Fast Water
tracks.description: An instrumental masterclass blending unhurried fingerstyle acoustic guitar with a tumbling, broken-beat hip-hop groove, colored by soaring lap steel and soothing river field recordings.

tracks.title: Last Shift
tracks.description: A slow, menacing Delta blues track about industrial displacement, featuring a rugged growling male vocal, a hypnotic one-chord resonator guitar drone, a dragging boot heel downbeat, and a dark, swamp-like atmosphere.

tracks.title: Sunfaded Postcards
tracks.description: A warm, tape-worn instrumental lo-fi dream sequence with swirling Rhodes, feather-light brushed drums, reversed guitars, and delicate harp accents drifting through a nostalgic haze.

tracks.title: Mountain Pass Express
tracks.description: An instrumental, dusty, late-night lofi hip-hop track featuring heavy boom-bap drums, a warbly Rhodes loop, deep sub bass, and psychedelic reversed elements, creating the atmosphere of a mountain train crossing.

tracks.title: Tilting Boardwalk
tracks.description: An evocative lofi instrumental painting the picture of an empty amusement pier after hours, filled with dusty swung drums, chorusy Rhodes, and shimmering harp reflections.

tracks.title: headspin cassette
tracks.description: Instrumental psychedelic lofi hip-hop at 77 BPM with a warm, tape-saturated cassette aesthetic. Features dusty boom-bap drums, a drifting Rhodes motif, detuned analog pads, and distant sitar plucks.

tracks.title: Wet Window Blues
tracks.description: An instrumental lo-fi dreamscape representing a rainy, pre-dawn city drive. Features warm vinyl crackle, filter-wobbled Rhodes, reversed guitars, sparkling harp, and ghostly vocal chops.
